title: Red Sox fend off Dodgers, 9-4, in grindy series opener
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Ceddanne Rafaela's seventh-inning homer helped the Red Sox to a 9-4 victory over the Dodgers, boosting playoff hopes.
Brayan Bello pitched four scoreless innings in relief, maintaining a 0.69 ERA in relief appearances this season.
The Red Sox set a franchise record with a 21-4 record in July, the best calendar month in team history.

title: Gabe Jacas makes his Patriots debut and other takeaways from Day 7 of training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Patriots defense notched two interceptions during Saturday's training camp, countering Drake Maye's performance.
Rookie Gabe Jacas made his limited practice debut, having been sidelined due to a knee issue.
Undrafted free agent Tanner Arkin impressed as a blocker, competing for a spot on the tight end depth chart.

title: Mass. to be 4th state to roll out EBT chip cards to curb fraud
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Massachusetts to distribute chip-enabled EBT cards statewide to prevent SNAP benefit theft, announced by Gov. Maura Healey.
The rollout follows a Worcester-area pilot; Massachusetts joins three other states with chip-and-tap EBT cards.
Recipients to activate cards within 60 days; new features include transaction locking via DTA Connect app.

title: Boston is now offering ‘pet certificates’ for couples who wed at City Hall
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Boston City Hall now offers a 'pet certificate' for couples marrying there to include their pets in the ceremony.
Mayor Michelle Wu announced the initiative, highlighting the importance of pets in family life and household unions.
The 'Family Companion Status Record' is the ceremonial certificate issued to pets, complete with a city seal and playful titles.

title: Kevin Nealon discusses Conan, Dunkin’, SNL and more ahead of local shows
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Kevin Nealon is set to perform in Boston and Portsmouth, NH, promoting his comedy special 'Loose in the Crotch.'
The former 'SNL' star enjoys engaging with fans through social media, using it to test material for his stand-up routines.
Nealon's 'Hiking with Kevin' YouTube series features celebrity interviews, inspired by his personal hiking experiences in LA.

title: Red Sox’ Willson Contreras leaves game after scary HBP vs. Dodgers
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox's Willson Contreras hit by 95 MPH fastball from Dodgers pitcher Will Klein in third inning.
Contreras initially stayed in the game but was removed for precautionary reasons the following inning.
Manager Chad Tracy reported Contreras underwent tests, appeared fine, but team awaits further updates on his condition.

title: After Patriots coaching stint, DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech staff
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech as assistant wide receivers coach after coaching at Patriots training camp.
Head coach David Key praises Hopkins for his offensive knowledge and leadership at Georgia Tech.
Hopkins's coaching stint includes work with former Patriots staff member Vinnie Sunseri at Georgia Tech.

title: Could Efton Chism and Kyle Williams both make the Patriots 53-man roster?
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Efton Chism and Kyle Williams are competing for spots on the Patriots' 53-man roster amid strong camp performances.
The Patriots have seven wide receivers competing for likely six roster spots, led by offseason acquisitions Brown and Doubs.
The team's decision may hinge on Kayshon Boutte's trade request status and Chism's potential preseason performance.

title: Reports: OF George Springer interested in trade to Red Sox, team eyeing INF Xavier Edwards
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: George Springer is interested in a trade to the Red Sox; he would not block a deal to Boston.
The Red Sox are linked to Blue Jays' George Springer and Marlins' infielder Xavier Edwards ahead of the trade deadline.
Xavier Edwards is an infielder with a .292 average and 18 stolen bases, fitting the Red Sox's infield needs.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'The Devil Wears Prada 2,' featuring Meryl Streep, is now streaming on Hulu.
'The Drama,' starring Zendaya and Robert Pattinson, is available on HBO Max.
'A Private Life,' a French mystery with Jodie Foster, is streaming on Netflix.
